evaluation.baseline_protocol: Separate runs with the same fixture, specialist implementations, check permissions, 48-request budget and 120-second deadline. Single specialist performs all phases. Independent majority uses the initial relevant specialist, skeptic and risk assessor with only their own evidence and no peer delivery. Council shares evidence, recruits capabilities and applies deterministic adjudication. Additional council observations and cost are reported, so this is a system comparison rather than an isolated proof that dialogue helps.
evaluation.limitations: 13 authored synthetic conditions: 7 development and 6 reserved stress cases. Holdout labels/variants are never sent to models; cases are now public and must not be described as independently collected or permanently unseen. No real-world superiority claim. Rule-mode results do not validate LLM reasoning. Memory timings exclude SLIM overhead; model billing and token pricing are not estimated. Precision/recall without a denominator are null. Intervals describe case-level accuracy uncertainty, not population validity.
